root_cause: The explicit public locale navigation fix changed assets/js/i18n.js but the generated public HTML kept the previous versioned asset URL.
Browser or CDN cache could therefore continue serving the pre-fix runtime while source and production commit identity were already current.

evidence.production_behavior: NL→EN browser click still timed out after exact-current-main deploy

prevention: Every production-critical behavior change to assets/js/i18n.js rotates I18N_ASSET_VERSION in tools/site-shell/apply-i18n.mjs.
Production readback proves both rotated asset identity and NL→EN→NL browser behavior.
Do not treat source-level runtime change as live until the generated HTML references the new asset identity.
